$comment: PAP-G2 wire contract for place_block / use_block (routes /v1/cplus/pa/*). Binding (world/session) is the accepted native handshake /v1/cplus/wn/bind. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, ensure_ascii) is byte-identical in Forge (PlayerActionFlow) and Python (cplus_pap_store); the receipt_hash is its sha256. A receipt is a CLAIM by Forge about one attempt, never a permission and never proof of exactly-once physical effect.

common.block_id: namespaced id (place: the block that must appear; use: the used block)
common.state_sha256: sha256 of the target cell state at preview

claims: every cell in {target cell, support cell (place only)} gets one ACTIVE claim; the cell must have no ACTIVE/HELD claim in cplus_pap_claims OR cplus_wn_claims (checked in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction by BOTH stores)

receipt.verified_place: interaction SUCCESS|CONSUME, after_block == target.block_id != before_block, item_before - item_after == 1, journal COMMITTED
receipt.verified_use: interaction SUCCESS|CONSUME, state_after != state_before, journal NOT_REQUIRED
receipt.refused: interaction PASS|FAIL and nothing changed (block, state, item count), journal NOT_REQUIRED

hold.intended: {} (no persist-only repair is offered for player actions)
hold.meaning: a real world effect may exist; it is neither rolled back nor repeated; claims stay HELD and the actor stays fenced until an operator reconcile from OBSERVED state

reconcile.rule: the observed state must support the class; the backend never claims the original attempt happened or not
